Aaftaab aur us ki raushni ki qasam
Aur chaand ki qasam jab woh us ke peechhe chale
Aur din ki qasam jab woh raushni bakhshe
Aur raat ki qasam jab woh use dhaank le
Aur aasmaan ki qasam aur jis ne use banaaya hai
Aur zameen ki qasam aur jis ne use bichhaaya hai
Aur nafs ki qasam aur jis ne use durust kiya hai
Phir badi aur taqwa ki hidaayat di hai
Beshak woh kaamyaab ho gaya jis ne nafs ko paakeeza bana liya
Aur woh naamuraad ho gaya jis ne use aalooda kar diya hai
Samood ne apni sarkashi ki bina par Rasool ki takzeeb ki
Jab un ka badbakht uth khada hua
To Khuda ke Rasool ne kaha ke Khuda ki oontni aur us ki seeraabi ka khayaal rakhna
To un logon ne us ki takzeeb ki aur us ki koonchein kaat daaleen, to Khuda ne un ke gunaah ke sabab un par azaab naazil kar diya aur unhein bilkul baraabar kar diya
Aur use us ke anjaam ka koi khauf nahin hai
